notes: The target is a held-out three-instruction composition absent from durable file memory.

The default finite breadth-first frontier retains a protected root plus bounded provisional hypotheses.
Admission consumes the same ordered scalar verifier stream used by the frontier; raw rows are not persisted.
This is bounded multi-step external-memory search, not open-ended program induction or general continual learning.
